claims.text: The driver's own profile trips the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check, and it trips on both limbs that clause requires: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 4, which is 4 or more, and 4 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, which is greater than 0.08. Because both limbs hold, the driver's compensation must be WITHHELD and the case escalates under POL-NS-09. No other profile field may be used for this check, and no such field is offered here.

That escalation is mandatory and, under POL-NS-09, terminal: the POL-NS-07 anti-farming trip engages trigger (d), no monetary ruling issues from the automated pipeline, and the disputed $4.50 is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded while the human review is pending. Under POL-GEN-03 an escalated amount is held rather than collected, so the rider is not left carrying the disputed charge while the review runs, and describing escalation as a refund to the rider would be wrong: it is a hold plus a directed refund.

POL-NS-07 also fixes what the escalation packet must contain where the anti-farming check trips: the packet must DIRECT THE REVIEWER to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full. The only sum in play is the $4.50 cancellation-fee line, which is the whole of total_charged on this trip, with refund_issued_sgd still 0.00 and payment_status CHARGED, so a direction to refund the rider in full reaches the entire contested amount and not a fragment of it.

The rider does not dispute the arrival and dwell arithmetic and does not pretend POL-NS-06 assists her: the driver's trace shows a single qualifying in-geofence run of 408 seconds against the 180 second minimum in force for this STANDARD-zone pickup (it would clear the legacy 300 second constant as well), carried by 42 qualifying fixes with a zero-second maximum gap. POL-NS-06 therefore does not make this fee refundable, and the rider's case is not a waiting-period shortfall: it is about whether this driver may receive the fee at all.

The arrival on this trip is not platform-confirmed, so POL-NS-12 has no application: trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON and not GPS_AUTO, which means the driver's 'I'm Here' tap and the wait-timer events are not a platform telemetry record of a full-resolution geofence measurement. The arrival marker is the driver's own assertion, and it stands or falls on the exported trace under POL-NS-02 and the POL-NS-05 false-marker test rather than on any independent platform measurement.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup, and the absence is itself citable: EV-ADVIS-02751-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and this claim is expressly advanced on an impaired (absent) artifact. Because the advisory is missing rather than present and populated, POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable, and no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT on the pickup road can be relied on by the driver to explain, extend or excuse any part of his waiting.

The rider's profile cannot be turned against her. rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags (1) is a lifetime counter and is not the no_show_disputes_30d that POL-NS-09(d) reads, and prior_disputes_filed (2) is not the disputes_with_counterparty_90d that POL-NS-09(c) reads; POL-GEN-01 makes both of them context only. On the fields the clauses actually name, the rider shows no_show_disputes_30d = 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 0, so no escalation trigger and no adverse finding can be constructed against her on profile.

claims.text: The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for this trip: DRV-09751 tapped 'I'm Here' at 22:31:15, which is limb (a) of POL-NS-01 satisfied on the platform's own telemetry, and the wait timer started two seconds later.

The driver's GPS trace places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m at the very second of the arrival event: his first qualifying in-geofence fix is timestamped 22:31:15, identical to the 'arrived' event, and 42 consecutive qualifying fixes follow from it. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are both satisfied.

The driver held position inside the pickup geofence for one continuous run of 408 seconds, from 22:31:15 to 22:38:03, carried by 42 in-radius fixes. That is more than double the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip, so limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied with 228 seconds to spare.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 22:38:07 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, well after the 180-second waiting period expired at 22:34:15, and the record shows no boarding event. Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied, and with all four limbs the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable.

The arrival marker is not a false marker under POL-NS-05. The first qualifying in-geofence fix shares the arrival timestamp 22:31:15 exactly, and the driver's approach speed falls to 0.0 kph as he holds the pickup, so there is no fix at the arrival moment placing him more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or above. My client's clock and his position agree at the marker.

There is no waiting-period shortfall. The measured in-geofence dwell of 408 seconds exceeds the required minimum, and the derived figure reports a shortfall of −228 seconds, i.e. a surplus. POL-NS-06 therefore licenses no refund of this fee.

EV-ADVIS-02751-01 is MISSING — no traffic advisory covers this pickup — so POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation of separate intervals is unavailable: the artifact carries weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that as POL-GEN-02 requires. It costs my client nothing, because he does not need accumulation: his dwell is a single uninterrupted in-geofence run.

The rider's own device track never approaches the pickup. Over 70 fixes from 22:28:47 to 22:39:10 it stays between 851 m and 858 m from the pickup pin, and only 0 of those fixes fall inside the STANDARD rider-presence radius of 100 m. On the rider's own telemetry, the rider was nowhere near the registered pickup point during the waiting window.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider and should not be read as if it could. The only message in the chat log is the driver's own 'im at the pickup point', sent 22:31:35 and read at 22:32:05; the rider sent nothing during the waiting window. Limb (a) of POL-NS-04 fails, so there is no unanswered rider message for limb (b) to bite on. The driver, not the rider, was the party trying to coordinate.

Where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the cancellation fee in force — SGD 3.60 of the SGD 4.50 charged, the net figure the fare breakdown itself reports as driver_compensation. That is the entitlement this verified no-show earns.

I will be straight about the one limb of POL-NS-07 that cuts against my own client, rather than overstate it. The anti-farming check trips on this record: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 4, which meets the '4 or more' limb, and 4 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (40) is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs engage, so compensation for this trip is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09 rather than paying out — notwithstanding that the no-show itself is fully established on this trip's own evidence, as claims 1 to 4 show. Only these two named counters are used; the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is not this test.

Nothing in this bundle is impaired under POL-NS-08. The GPS trace has 100 percent coverage at a 10-second cadence with max_gap_sec of 0.0, the 'arrived' event and the first in-geofence fix share the timestamp 22:31:15 (no clock skew), and the fare breakdown's SGD 4.50 cancellation line reconciles to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. No limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged, so no impairment caps confidence on the driver's arrival and dwell below the 0.70 floor.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: on this trip's own facts the no-show is established. DRV-09751 accepted at 22:22:34, tapped 'I'm Here' at 22:31:15, and the GPS trace independently places him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius from that same second, holding position for one continuous 408-second run (42 qualifying fixes) until 22:38:03 — well past the 180-second free waiting period in force. The driver cancelled at 22:38:07 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, no boarding event is recorded, and the rider's own device track never came closer than 851 m to the pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) are therefore satisfied and the SGD 4.50 fee would normally stand, with SGD 3.60 (80% of the fee) paid to the driver under POL-NS-07.

That payout is displaced by the driver's own profile, on a check the driver's advocate properly conceded. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming test requires both limbs and both are met: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 4 (the '4 or more' limb) and 4 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb. Where both limbs hold, compensation is WITHHELD and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). Escalation is terminal: no money moves now, both money fields are null, and the disputed SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded while a human reviewer decides. The reviewer's packet carries both briefs, the pre-pass report, the clauses relied on and this reasoning, and directs a full refund of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee.

I tested and set aside the routes either side raised. POL-NS-06: the measured dwell of 408 seconds exceeds the 180-second minimum, the derived shortfall is −228 seconds (a surplus), so no waiting-period refund arises; the absent traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02751-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) is irrelevant to a dwell that needs no accumulation. POL-NS-05: the arrival marker is true — the fix at the marker shares the timestamp 22:31:15 and the driver is stationary, not the 300 m or 15 km/h that would make it false. POL-NS-04: the only message in the waiting window is the driver's own, so the rider sent nothing locating or coordinating and limb (a) fails — no rider exoneration. POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so the arrival rests on the exported trace, which fully supports it. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08 (zero-second gap, no clock skew, chat count reconciles to the trip record, fare line reconciles to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd), and every deciding fact rests on weight-1.0 records, so confidence is not capped below the floor; escalation is triggered by POL-NS-09(d), not by low confidence. I did not use rating, account age, lifetime trips, cancellation rate or the lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags / prior_disputes_filed on either party: POL-GEN-01 makes them context only, and the only profile counters that decide anything here are the two POL-NS-07 names. The sum at issue (the SGD 4.50 held) is below the SGD 8.00 POL-GEN-05 execution threshold, but escalation is terminal and that amount stays frozen.
referrals: POL-NS-07: the escalation packet must direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 in full.

ruling.explanation: To both parties. The no-show itself is established on this trip's own evidence and neither side disputes it. POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs: (a) the trip record carries the driver's 'I'm Here' event at 22:31:15; (b) the GPS trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that same timestamp — 42 consecutive qualifying fixes begin at 22:31:15 — which also satisfies POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-fix proximity test; (c) the driver then held position continuously for 408 seconds (22:31:15 to 22:38:03), well beyond the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip; and (d) the driver terminated the trip at 22:38:07 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event, after the waiting period had elapsed. The rider's advocate expressly accepts this arithmetic. The check that decides the case is POL-NS-07's anti-farming test, and it trips on both limbs it requires: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 4 (the threshold is '4 or more'), and 4 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb. Both advocates agree on this, and the driver discloses it against his own interest rather than overstate his case. Compensation is therefore withheld and the case escalates. On the other routes: POL-NS-05 does not apply — the arrival marker at 22:31:15 coincides with the first in-geofence fix with no positioning beyond 300 m and no motion at 15 km/h or above, so no false-arrival record is produced. POL-NS-06 does not apply — 408 seconds of dwell against a 180-second minimum is a surplus (the derived shortfall figure is minus 228 seconds), so no waiting-period refund arises. POL-NS-03 does not apply — the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: limb (a) fails because the only chat message in the log is the driver's own, sent at 22:31:35, and the rider's own device track stays 851 to 858 m from the pickup pin across all 70 fixes, never entering the 100 m presence radius; the rider is not thereby found to have done anything wrong, but the exoneration clause does not reach her. POL-NS-12 has no application because arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO. On evidence weight under POL-GEN-02: nothing in the bundle is impaired under POL-NS-08 — the GPS trace has 100 percent coverage, a 10-second cadence and a 0.0-second maximum gap; the 'arrived' event and the first in-geofence fix share the timestamp 22:31:15, so there is no clock skew; and the SGD 4.50 fare line reconciles to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so the fare limb is clean. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02751-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) can carry no fact, but no limb of this decision relies on it. Confidence is capped by the artifacts that carry the deciding facts, all at weight 1.0. Under POL-GEN-01 the profile fields mentioned outside the tests that name them (prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed) are context only and were not used against either party. The escalation under POL-NS-09(d) is TERMINAL: no money moves now, and the disputed SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is placed on hold — neither collected nor refunded — while the human review is pending. The escalation packet directs the reviewer, under POL-NS-07, to refund that sum to the rider in full. The open question for the reviewer is whether the platform's anti-farming rule should withhold the driver's compensation on this trip given his trailing-30-day record; that is a matter for the reviewer under POL-GEN-06(4) and is not a referral.
referrals: POL-NS-07: the escalation packet must DIRECT THE REVIEWER to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 in full.
